dataRoles.name: x
dataRoles.description: X axis (category or measure). Use 'Don't summarize' for raw numeric values. A 2nd/3rd measure feeds segment ends (x2) and point ranges (x2=min, x3=max).

dataRoles.name: y
dataRoles.description: Y axis values. Each field maps to a layer (up to 3). Use 'Don't summarize' for raw values.

dataRoles.name: size
dataRoles.description: Point size for bubble charts. Use 'Don't summarize' for raw values.

dataRoles.name: detail
dataRoles.description: Point identity/detail grouping. Use this to draw one point per item when X or Y is a measure.

dataRoles.name: label
dataRoles.description: Text labels for geom_text layers. Blank values are not drawn.

yField.description: Which Y field this layer uses (ggplot2: aes(y=) override per layer). Works for both measures and raw Y fields (Don't summarize).

filter.description: Restrict this layer to a subset of rows: Min / Max keep the row with the lowest / highest value on the continuous axis per category, Extremes keeps both (dumbbell ends).

labelTemplate.description: Template for label text, e.g. '{label} {x:.1%}'. Placeholders {label}, {x}, {y}; optional d3-format spec after the colon.

repel.description: Text labels find non-overlapping positions (like ggrepel); displaced labels get a connector line.

applyHighlight.description: Whether the Highlight card affects this layer. Off = the layer keeps full colours (text layers: all labels).

labelFormat.description: Number format for the tick labels. Separators, symbols and compact suffixes follow the report locale.

dateFormat.description: Granularity for a time axis. Auto follows the tick spacing; month names always come from the report locale.

labelFormat.description: Number format for the tick labels. Separators, symbols and compact suffixes follow the report locale.

dateFormat.description: Granularity for a time axis. Auto follows the tick spacing; month names always come from the report locale.

preset.description: Base theme; the colour pickers below override individual parts.

subtitle.description: A line above the plot stating what is shown, including transformations the visual applied itself (summing, binning, an auto-picked geom). 'Auto' only shows it when there is something to explain.

warnAggregated.description: Say so when a row-counting chart (histogram, count bars, boxplot, density, violin) runs on data where no field identifies a row — Power BI may have collapsed duplicates before the visual saw them.

showCode.description: Overlay the ggpbi code that would produce this chart — for learning the API, copying a chart into the library, or attaching a reproducible example to a bug report.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code used when an axis label format is set to Currency (EUR, USD, CHF). Symbol and placement follow the report locale.

values.description: Comma-separated values of the Color field to highlight; everything else turns grey and leaves the legend (like R's gghighlight).

trim.description: Density layers: clip the curve to the observed data range (ggplot2 trim, default off).

violinTrim.description: Violin layers: clip each violin to its group's data range (ggplot2 trim, default on).

densityFill.description: Density layers: fill the area under the curve with the line colour.

hlineAt.description: Y positions: numbers (comma-separated) or 'mean' / 'median' of the Y values. Example: mean, 30

vlineAt.description: X positions: numbers (comma-separated) or 'mean' / 'median' of the X values.

columns.description: Number of grid columns. 0 = automatic, like ggplot2's facet_wrap: a roughly square grid (6 panels → 3 × 2).

freeX.description: Each panel scales its X axis to its own data (ggplot2 scales = "free_x"). Needed when every panel covers a different range, e.g. one decade each.

freeY.description: Each panel scales its Y axis to its own data (ggplot2 scales = "free_y").
